title: Freepik Automation: How to Automate Creative Workflows (2026)
summary: Freepik automation connects your design software directly to the platform's library to streamline asset retrieval.
body_markdown:
## Step 3: Connect Freepik to your publishing stack with Activepieces


Activepieces is the logic layer that moves Freepik assets into your production environment by mapping API response data to the specific input fields of your CMS or database.


While a standard API call only retrieves a URL, this automation engine handles the authentication handshakes and file binary transfers required to turn a raw search result into a published featured image.


Instead of searching a static library of templates for this specific Freepik-to-CMS connection, you can describe the desired logic to the built-in AI chat to have it construct and publish a runnable flow.


Ask the AI chat for a workflow with no template (for example, "when a Stripe payment fails twice, create a HubSpot task and message the account owner on Slack") and watch it build and publish that flow instead of returning a search result.


### Triggering workflows on new search results


Automated retrieval begins by using the Activepieces HTTP module to poll the Freepik API for new assets matching specific metadata tags.


This approach eliminates the need for creators to manually browse the marketplace. The workflow only activates when the API detects a new file that meets your predefined orientation and color profile filters.


To ensure the pipeline doesn't process the same image twice, you'll need to configure an integration to compare the unique Resource ID from the Freepik response against a local cache.


### Automating the upload to WordPress or Webflow


A multi-step sequence is required to move a high-resolution file from Freepik’s servers to a CMS like WordPress to handle file sideloading and metadata assignment.


The system must follow this specific order of operations to ensure the asset is correctly indexed in the media library before it attempts to attach it to a specific post or page.


1. Trigger on new CMS tag
2. Search Freepik API with filters
3. Download high-res via Resource ID
4. Upload to WordPress Media Library
5. Update post featured image


By passing the Freepik download URL directly into the WordPress "Upload Media" action, you'll bypass the need to store large files on your local machine. This prevents storage bottlenecks during high-volume content migrations.


If the specific connector for your niche CMS or internal tool is missing from the 748 integrations currently in the open-source monorepo, you can generate the integration with AI and add it privately to your instance, meaning you are never blocked by a lack of native support.


This capability ensures the catalog is a floor for your automation rather than a ceiling, allowing teams like MoneyGram and FundingSocieties to run custom logic without waiting for a vendor release cycle.


### Logging asset usage in Airtable for license compliance


Maintaining a legal audit trail requires capturing the attribution requirements provided by the Freepik API and storing them alongside your internal project data.


Activepieces sends the author name and license type from the API response to a relational database tool like Airtable. This creates a permanent link between the published URL and the original asset source.


Your legal team can verify compliance without manually searching through thousands of historical downloads.
